spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Lustful, libidinous.
E.
अभि, and क from कम to desire.

m. (-कः)
1 A poet.
2 A husband.
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Lustful, libidinous.
2 Anxious, desirous.
3

Cruel.
4

Fearless.
E.
अभि before क, from कम to desire: the इ being made long irregularly.

f. (-ङ्गा)
Wish, desire.
E.
अभि, and काङ्क्षा desire.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wished, desired.
E.
अभि and काङ्क्षित.

mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि)
Wishing, desirous.
E.
अभि, and काङ्क्षिन् who wishes.

m. (-मः)
Assault, attack, invasion.
2 Mounting, ascending.
E.
अभि before or beyond, क्रम to go, and घञ् affix; see अतिक्रम.

f. (-ख्या)
1 A name or appellation.
2 Calling, addressing.
3

Beauty.
4

Fame, glory.
E.
अभि, ख्या to speak, अङ् affix, and टाप् fem. aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Approached.
E.
अभि near to, गत gone.

m. (-मः)
Approach, proximity.
E.
अभि to, गम going.

n. (-नं)
Approaching, going near to.
E.
अभि, and गमन going.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Approaching.
E.
अभि, and गामिन् who goes.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Overcome, subdued.
E.
अभि, and ग्रस्त seized.

m. (-हः)
1 Attack, onset.
2 Challenge, going to fight.
3 Plundering, robbing.
4 Celebrity.
E.
अभि before, in presence of, ग्रह to take, and अप् aff.

n. (-णं)
Robbing, seizing any thing in presence of the owner.
E.
अभि before ग्रह to take, and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Rubbing, friction.
2 Possession by an evil spirit.
E.
अभि before घृष to pound, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 Striking, wounding, beating.
2 Touching, contact.
3 Pain, infliction, torture.
4 Remedy, removal.
n. (-तं)
The combination of the fourth letter of any class with any of the other three preceding it.
E.
अभि before हन to strike, affix घञ्.

m. (-ती)
An enemy.
mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
1 Hostile, an assailant.
2 Inflicting injury.
3 Remedial.
E.
अभि before हन to strike or kill, and णिनि aff.

m. (-रः)
Ghee or clarified butter.
E.
अभि, घृ to scatter, घञ् aff.

m. (-रः)
A servant.
E.
अभि after, and चर who goes.

m. (-रः)
Magic for a malevolent purpose, the spells and diagrams of the Atharva Veda and some of the Tantras, supposed to produce mental aberration, love, hatred, loss of feeling or paralysis, and death.
E.
अभि before चर to go, and घञ् aff.

m. (-न्त्रः)
A formula or prayer for working a charm, an incantation.
E.
अभिचार, and मन्त्र a formula.

m. (-कः-की-कं)
Magical, magician, relating to spells or magic.
E.
अभिचार and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Inchanted, charmed.
E.
अभिचार and क्त aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Magical, done by magic.
2 Magician or one employing spells, a conjuror, a witch, &c.
E.
अभिचार, and इनि aff.

m. (-द्यः)
A name of ŚIŚUPĀLA.
E.
अभि over, चैद्य the people of Cedi.

m. (-नः)
1 Family, race.
2 Native country.
3 The head or ornament of a family.
4 Fame, notoriety.
E.
अभि before जन who is born, from जन to be born, घञ् affix, the vowel remaining short.

n. (-नं)
Loftiness of birth.
E.
अभिजन family, अण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Noble, well born.
2 Wise, learned.
3 Fit, proper.
4

Handsome.
5

Respectable.
E.
अभि before जात produced.

f. (-जित्)
1 One of the Nakṣatras or lunar asterisms.
2 The eighth muhūrtta or hour.
2 An expiatory sacrifice.
E.
अभि, and जित् what conquers.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Skilful, clever.
2 One who knows or understands.
E.
अभि, and ज्ञ who knows, from ज्ञा to know, क affix leaving अ; आ is dropped.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Known, understood.
2 Detected, discovered.
E.
अभि, and ज्ञात known.

n. (-नं)
1 A mark, a spot or stain.
2 A sign, a token.
3 Ascertaining, knowledge.
E.
अभि before ज्ञा to know, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Scorched, burnt.
2 Afflicted.
E.
अभि, and तप्त burnt.

ind.
1

Quickly.
2

Entirely.
3

Before, in presence of.
4 On both sides.
5 Near.
E.
अभि and तसिल् aff.

m. (-पः)
1 Extreme heat.
2 Agitation, affliction, emotion.
E.
अभि, and ताप heat.

m. (-हः)
1 Oppression, cruelty.
2 Abuse.
E.
अभि, and द्रोह violence.

f. (-धा)
1 A name, an appellation.
2 (In logic,) the power or sense of a word.
3 The chief or common acceptation of a word.
E.
अभि before धा to have, क affix and टाप् fem.: what any thing is obtained by.

f. (-धा)
Sound.
E.
अभिधा a compound root, to name, अङ् and टाप् affixes, and आङ् prefix.

n. (-नं)
1 A name, an appellation.
2 Speaking, speech.
3 A vocabulary, a dictionary.
E.
as before, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Denominative, relating to.
E.
अभिधायिन् with कन् added.

mfn. (-यौ-यिनी-यि)
Denominative, appellative.
E.
अभि before धा to have, णिनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Pursuit, chase.
E.
अभि, and धावन running.

f. (-त्सा)
Direction, injunction.
2 Desire, wish.
E.
अभि before धा to have, desiderative form, क and टाप् affs.

n. (-यं)
1 A name or appellation.
2 A significant word.
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be named or mentioned.
E.
अभि before धा, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unmeaning, nonsensical, having no sense nor meaning.
E.
अभिधेय, and रहित void of.

f. (-ध्या)
1 Coveting another's property.
2 Desire, longing for in general.
E.
अभि, ध्ये to think, and अङ् aff.

n. (नं)
1 Coveting, desiring, longing for.
2 Meditation, profound thought.
E.
अभि before ध्यै to think of, ल्युट् affix, or ध्यान contemplation.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Bound, tied round, fastened on or upon.
E.
अभि over, नद्ध tied.

m. (-नः)
The fourth Jaina Tīrthakara or deified saint.
n. (-नं)
Delighting, rejoicing.
E.
अभि before नदि to please, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-न्दा)
Wish, expectation.
E.
अभि and नदि to please, affix अच् and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Delighted, made happy.
E.
अभि, and नन्दित pleased.

m. (-यः)
1 Indication of a passion or purpose by look, gesture, &c.
2 Acting, dramatic personification.
3 Ornament, decoration.
4 Civility, kindness.
E.
अभि, णीञ्^1 to guide, and अच् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 314. note: Cf WIL and WIL1819 णी.

New.
2

Young.
E.
अभि before नव new.

m. (-द् or -त्)
A germin, a new bud.
E.
अभिनव new, and उद्भिद् produced.

m. (-क्तः)
One asleep at sun-set.
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Left, quitted.
E.
अभि always, निर्म्मुक्त released.

n. (-णं)
Invasion, march of an assailant, or march in general.
E.
अभि, and निर् prefixed to या to go, and ल्युट् aff.

(-त्तिः)
Accession of disease.
E.
अभि, and निर्वृत्ति inaction.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Conversant or familiar with, studied in.
2 Attentive, engrossed.
E.
अभि, and निविष्ट entered.

m. (-शः)
1 Intentness, application, perseverance, determination to effect a purpose, or attain an object.
2

Tenacity.
3

Study.
4

Ignorant fear causing death.
E.
अभि and नि before विश to enter, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
Going forth or out, issuing, exit.
E.
अभि and निर् before क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Gone out or forth.
E.
अभि, and निष्क्रान्त gone out.

n. (-नं)
Sallying, issuing, going forth.
E.
अभि before निष्पतन going out.

f. (-त्तिः)
End, termination.
E.
अभि, and निष्पत्ति discontinuance.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Finished, completed^1.
E.
अभि, and निष्पन्न done.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-नः)
1 The soft aspirate.
2 A letter of the alphabet.
E.
अभि and नि before ष्ठा to stay or stand, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (तः-ता-तं)
1 Fit, proper.
2 Friendly, kind.
3 Highly finished, or ornamented.
4

Patient.
5

Impatient.
6

Passionate.
E.
अभि and णीञ्^1 to guide or obtain, क्त aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 314. note: Cf WIL and WIL1819 णी.

f. (-तिः)
1 Friendship, civility, kindness.
2 Gesture, expressive gesticulation.
E.
अभि, and नीति conduct.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be represented dramatically.
E.
अभि before नी to guide, यत् aff.

mf. (ता-त्री-)
An actor, an actress.
E.
अभि before नी to guide, तृच् aff.

mfn. (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Same, identical.
2 One, undivided.
3 Unchanged, unaltered.
4 Uncut, unbroken.
m. (-न्नः)
An integer, a whole number.
E.
अ neg. भिन्न other.

f. (-ता)
Identity, wholeness.
E.
तल् added to the last, or with त्व, अभिन्नत्वं.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1

Guilty.
2

Unfortunate, calamitous.
3

Subdued.
4

Flown, fugitive.
5 Seeking refuge.
E.
अभि before पद to go, in the part. past.

Propitiation.
2

Affection, favour.
E.
अभि and प्र before णी, affix अच्.

mfn. (तः-ता-तं)
1 Invoked, propitiated.
2

Consecrated.
3

Brought, attracted.
E.
अभि and प्र before णी to conduct, क्त aff.

m. (-यः)
1 Meaning, intention, wish, purpose.
2 Meaning, a sentence, sense.
3 The main purport of a book.
E.
अभि, and प्रिञ् to satisfy, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Meant, intended.
2

Wished.
3

Wishing, desirous, ambitious of, pretending to.
E.
अभि, and प्र before इण to go, क्त aff.

ind.
Intending, meaning.
E.
अभि and प्र before इण to go, क्यप् aff.

n. (-णं)
Sprinkling, affusion.
E.
अभि and प्रोक्षण sprinkling.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Overflowed, overrun, filled with.
2 Attacked or affected by, labouring under.
E.
अभि before प्लु to go, क्त aff.

m. (-वः)
1 Defeat, subjugation.
2 Humiliation, disgrace.
E.
अभि implying inferiority, and भव being; from भू to be, and अप् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Overpowering, overcoming.
2 Being overpowered.
E.
अभि, भू to be, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Humbled, surpassed, defeated, subdued.
2

Ignorant.
3

Overcome with feelings or wants, with passion, with hunger, &c.
4 Injured, aggrieved.
E.
अभि, and भूत been, being; part. past.

f. (-तिः)
Disrespect, disgrace, humiliation.
E.
अभि before भू to be, and क्तिन् fem. aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wished, desired.
2 Agreed, accepted.
3 Admitted, assented to.
E.
अभि over, मत thought.

f. (-ता)
1 Desire, love.
2 Agreeableness, desirableness.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, अभिमतत्वं.

n. (-णं)
1 Calling to, addressing, inviting.
2

Counselling.
3

Consecrating any thing by a special formula.
E.
अभि in presence, मन्त्र to speak, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Charmed, consecrated, had a certain formula pronounced over it.
E.
अभि, मन्त्र to charm, affix क्त.

m. (-न्ता)
1 A counsellor, a monitor.
2 Conscience.
mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Who or what admonishes or advises.
E.
अभि, and मन to mind, तृच् aff.

m. (-न्थः)
Ophthalmia, disease of the eyes.
E.
अभि, and मन्थ to agitate, घञ् affix; also read अधिमन्थः.

m. (-न्युः)
The son of ARJUNA by SUBHADRĀ.
E.
अभि, and मन wrath.

m. (-रः)
1 Killing, slaughter.
2 War, combat.
3 Binding, confinement.
4 Treachery, danger from one's own party or friends.
E.
अभि before मर from मृ to die, and अप् aff.

m. (-र्द्दः)
1 Rubbing, friction.
2 Devastation of a country, &c. by an enemy.
3 War, battle.
E.
अभि, and मृद् to tread down, अच् aff.

n. (-नं)
Touching, rubbing.
E.
अभि before मृश to rub, with ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Sprinkling upon or over.
2 Licking the lips as an indication of guilt or prevarication.
E.
अभि, and मृष to sprinkle, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-तिः)
An enemy.
E.
अभि against, and सा to measure, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-नः)
1 Pride, haughtiness.
2

Knowledge.
3

Affection.
4

Injury, hurting, killing.
5 Requesting.
E.
अभि, and मन to know, with घञ् affix, or मी to injure, and ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Pride.
E.
See अभिमान, the इ being made long.

f. (-ता)
Pride, arrogance.
E.
तल् added to the last: also अभिमानत्वं.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Proud, arrogant.
f. (-ती)
Pride.
E.
मतुप् poss. affix; added to अभिमान.

n. (-तं)
Copulation.
E.
अभि, and मन to know, in the causal form, and क्त aff.
f. (-ता)
Pride, arrogance.
E.
अभिमानिन्, and तल् aff.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Proud, arrogant.
E.
अभिमान and इनि aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Subdued, reduced, broken or worn down.
2 Stupid, ignorant.
E.
अभि before माया ignorance, illusion.

Present.
2

Near to, in front of.
n. adv. (-खं)
In front or presence of.
E.
अभि before, and मुख the face.

f. (-ता)
Presence, proximity.
E.
अभिमुख, and तल् affix or with त्व, अभिमुखत्वं.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Touched, rubbed, brought or passed close.
E.
अभि, and मृष्ट rubbed.

m. (-तिः)
An enemy.
E.
अभि against, या to go, with अति affix, see अभियातिन्.

m. (-ती)
An enemy.
E.
अभि against, यत् to strive, and णिनि affix, see अभिघातिन्.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Attacked by an enemy, assaulted, assailed.
2 Diligent, intent.
3 Said, spoken.
4 Blamed, rebuked.
5 (In law) Charged, prosecuted, defendant.
E.
अभि, and युक्त joined.

f. (-ता)
1 Diligence, application.
2 Accusation, prosecution.
E.
अभियुक्त and तल् affix; also with त्व, अभियुक्तत्वं.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Blamable, to be reproved or rebuked.
2 To be prevented or prohibited.
3 To be prosecuted, indictable.
4 To be pursued diligently.
E.
अभि before युज to join, तव्य aff.

m. (-क्ता)
A plaintiff, an accuser.
mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ)
One who assails another in any way.
E.
अभि before युज to join, तृच् aff.

m. (-गः)
1 Attack, assault.
2 Challenging to fight.
3 War, battle.
4 Energetic effort, exertion, perseverance.
5 Reprimand, reproof.
5 Prohibition, prevention.
7 Contact, conjunction.
8 (In law) A plaint, a charge, an accusation.
E.
अभि, युज to joint, and घञ् affix, ज being changed to ग.

m. (-गी)
A plaintiff, a prosecutor.
mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
One who assails another in any way.
E.
अभियोग and इनि aff.

f. (-क्षा)
Universal protection, wide benevolence.
E.
अभि, and रक्षा preserving.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Guarded, preserved, kept.
E.
अभि, and रक्षित preserved.

m. (-ता)
1 A guardian.
2 A controller.
mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what keeps or preserves.
E.
अभि, रक्षितृ who preserves.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pleased or contented with, satisfied.
2 Performing, practising, engaged in, attentive to.
E.
अभिरम to sport, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Pleasure, delight.
2 Practice, occupation.
E.
अभि, and रति pleasure.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Propitiated, (by penance, &c.)
E.
अभि, and राद्ध accomplished.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Beautiful.
E.
अभि before रम to sport, and घञ् aff.

f. (-ता)
Beauty, splendour.
E.
तल् added to the last: also अभिरामत्वं.

f. (-चिः)
1 Ambition, desire of fame.
2 Desire in general.
3 Taste, relish.
4 Splendour.
E.
अभि, and रुचि light.

m. (-पः)
1 A learned Brahman, a

Paṇḍita.
2
A name of

KĀMA.
3

Of the moon.
4 Of Ś

IVA.
5

Also of VIṢṆU.
mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं)
1

Learned.
2

Pleasing.
3

Handsome.
E.
अभि before रूप to have form, affix क.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Desirable.
E.
अभि before लष to wish, अनीयर aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Desired, wished.
n. (-तं)
Desire.
E.
अभि before लष with क्त part. aff.

m. (-पः)
1 Speech, speaking.
2 Declaration of the object of a vow or religious obligation.
E.
अभि before लप to speak, घञ् aff.

Reaping.
2

Cutting.
E.
अभि, and लूञ्^1 to cut, aff. घञ्.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

m. (-षः)
Wish, desire.
E.
अभि, and लष to like, घञ् aff; also अभिलास.

m. (-सः)
Wish, desire.
E.
